paper.title: SKILLFOUNDRY: Building Self-Evolving Agent Skill Libraries from Heterogeneous Scientific Resources
paper.central_claim: 通过树引导采矿、验证修复与库治理，把异质科学资源转为有效且新颖的可重用技能，提高科学代理表现。

provenance.notes: 执行上下文声明gpt-6.1-sol；无可独立验证模型回执、会话ID或运行记录引用，留null；未探测配置。

evidence.quote: . Together, these studies highlight the value of reusable and evolving skills. Our setting differs in that we focus on mining skills from heterogeneous domain resources, rather than constructing them primarily from trajectories, failures, reinforcement learning, or manual engineering.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者谱系区别；邻居原文未核验。

evidence.quote: , each skill records its scope, dependencies, inputs, outputs, provenance, and example usage. In the repository, a compiled skill includes both human-readable instructions and machine-readable metadata, together with executable scripts or tests when available. The refresh stage then updates the registry so that subsequent iterations operate on an accurate view of coverage and gaps in the library.
evidence.support_explanation: 持久化合同、注册表与后续读取。

evidence.quote: Synthetic-data testing is used when live resources are unavailable, expensive, unstable, or difficult to exercise repeatedly during development. Rather than approximating the full downstream task, it checks whether the skill correctly consumes controlled inputs, supports all required arguments and file interfaces specified by the skill contract, and produces stable outputs under fixed mock conditions.
evidence.support_explanation: 内部测试只保合同而非科学语义正确。

evidence.quote: , using keywords derived from the candidate skill’s task description. A mined skill is considered novel if no existing skill is found that completes the same task. Among the mined skills, 71.1% satisfy this criterion and are added as new leaves in the domain knowledge tree.
evidence.support_explanation: 71.1%是库检索新颖性，不是科学贡献的证明或召回率审计。

evidence.quote: skills improves performance on five of the six datasets and leaves one unchanged. Averaged over all six datasets, Repo-Acc increases from 61.19% to 66.73%, and Paper-Acc increases from 43.85% to 53.05%.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定技能库开启/关闭的下游效用；双评分处理benchmark规范差异。

evidence.quote: markedly outperforms vanilla Codex in both coverage and accuracy, reaching 99.2% coverage and 82.9% accuracy, compared with 81.1% and 68.5%, respectively (Figure
evidence.support_explanation: 单数据集细胞标注收益，不能把228635细胞当独立演化重复。

evidence.quote: We run each setting for three replicates and compare the outputs against expert reference analyses in a blinded evaluation by statistical genetics experts.
evidence.support_explanation: 外部专家参考、盲评、三次消费者重复；不是三次技能搜索。

evidence.quote: is the only setting that satisfies all seven qualitative criteria, and it also produces exact agreement with the expert scores in two of three runs, compared with one of three runs for Biomni alone. Its mean RMSE is substantially lower, decreasing from 0.11 to 0.02.
evidence.support_explanation: 给完整三次分母及不完整报告负例；两种评分互补。

evidence.quote: When this layer fails, the framework enters a repair loop that attempts to diagnose the failure, revise the implementation or test surface, and rerun the check.
evidence.support_explanation: 实施反馈修复留存对象，但测试表面本身可被修改。

evidence.quote: constructs skill versus no skill comparisons on task specific cases and checks whether the maintained wrapper provides a meaningful advantage over an ad hoc baseline. If the advantage is weak or inconsistent, the framework enters an optimization loop that revises the skill and benchmarks it again.
evidence.support_explanation: 效用门参与优化；需要独立最终留出，未写清相互隔离。

evidence.quote: is conservative in how it mutates shared repository state. Resource search and skill construction can run in isolated worker workspaces, but only leaf owned artifacts are merged automatically. Shared global files, including registries, reports, and site summaries, remain refresh owned.
evidence.support_explanation: 并行隔离、共享写入所有权明确。

evidence.quote: The reported cost therefore reflects runtime rather than API token usage, and it measures controlled retrieval under a fixed search budget rather than open-ended search.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本仅受控采矿阶段时间；未全量token/货币成本。

evidence.quote: Second, most mined skills have so far been validated primarily through the framework’s internal testing pipeline rather than through broad downstream evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认验证范围局限。

G.reason: 异质资源转可用技能的gap具体并涵盖Voyager、EvoSkill、Paper2Agent和ToolRosetta；邻居独立核验及工具/技能残余差异尚不充分。

M.reason: 树状态引导采矿→合同→执行/效用修复→合并剔除→刷新，回应资源碎片化；边际价值启发式、停止条件与真实性假设未充分形式化。

X.reason: 注册、来源和并行写入职责明确；促升阈值、退役回退、拆分独立性与模拟测试语义认证不足，不因有版本/测试即满分。

E.measurement.reason: Repo/Paper双评分、标注真值和专家RMSE/盲评互补；新颖性仅关键词检索且内部测试不等同语义有效，缺完整专家库审计。

E.causality.reason: 同配置技能on/off和外部Biomni有效用对照；没有树/门/等资源原始文档对照，不能把收益归给自演化机制。

E.holdout.reason: 既有库用于MoSciBench给后续使用线索，但资源/benchmark重叠与冻结时间不明；定制任务有benchmark驱动优化，未证明测试独立。

E.statistics.reason: scDRS给3次完整分母和失败类型，无跨采矿种子/CI/显著性；MoSciBench及标注主对照无完整不确定性。

E.cost.reason: 受控搜索阶段runtime明确，未报完整构建、失败、调用/部署成本及公平预算。

reason: 全文含附录已读；范围内非权重技能库闭环，效用证据支持受限留存结论。
